title: FHWA IIJA: outlays rise from 49.3 to 55.4 percent while authority expands
summary: FHWA obligations rose from $180.678 billion to $262.910 billion and outlays from $112.370 billion to $177.778 billion between the two DOT statements; obligation share rose 2.7 points and outlay share rose 6.1 points. Denominator: FHWA formula-plus-discretionary IIJA funding; adjusted authority changed from $227.871 billion to $320.662 billion.
